about_short_description.short_description: B2B construction marketplace to match contractors and subcontractors

product.name: CoCrafter Marketplace
product.description: A digital platform where subcontractors create verified profiles to view and apply for detailed construction project tenders.

product.name: Subcontractor Management Automation ('Auto-Pilot')
product.description: A software tool that automates subcontractor administration, including document management, project communication, and compliance tracking.

product.name: Subcontractor and Project Matching Service
product.description: A service that connects general contractors with qualified subcontractors across multiple construction trades for project collaboration.

product.name: Document and Compliance Verification System
product.description: A system for collecting, verifying, and managing subcontractor legal and qualification documents to ensure compliance with construction regulations.

identifier.value: Project Tender and Offer Comparison Tool

product.name: Project Tender and Offer Comparison Tool
product.description: A feature that allows contractors to compare offers from multiple subcontractors based on price, qualifications, and availability for specific projects.
